description: Register an https URL to receive events as Standard Webhooks: a POST with webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature (v1, HMAC-SHA256 of id.timestamp.body with the secret returned here, once). scope mine sends your own polls' events, public every public poll's; poll_id narrows it to one poll. Only events after it is made are sent. Answer 2xx to acknowledge; failures are retried for about three days, and 410 stops deliveries. (POST /api/v1/webhooks)

events.description: Which event types to send. Default: all.

scope.description: mine: your own polls. public: every public poll.

name: create_webhook
title: Create a webhook
